assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Super Simple Songs - Kids Songs 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Super Simple Songs Inc.（加拿大公司）。企业隶属关系链。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家。
  5. 使用的语言。
  6. 主要内容类别（儿童童谣）。
  7. 内容供应模式：原创／委托制作的动画。
  8. 代表作品。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Super Simple Songs 排名第 32 名，历史累计观看量约为 64B（640 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Super Simple Songs 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml: SUPER SIMPLE SONGS - KIDS SONGS: COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER

evidence.snippet: Channel display name: 'Super Simple Songs - Kids Songs'. Channel ID: UCLsooMJoIpl_7ux2jvdPB-Q. Also accessible at https://www.youtube.com/c/supersimplesongs and https://www.youtube.com/user/SuperSimpleSongs.
evidence.supports: Field 1: Stable channel ID (UCLsooMJoIpl_7ux2jvdPB-Q) and canonical URLs confirmed.

evidence.snippet: 'SUPER SIMPLE SONGS' is a trademark of SKYSHIP ENTERTAINMENT COMPANY. Original registrant: Super Simple Learning, Inc. Skyship Entertainment Company, 27 Atlantic Avenue, Toronto, Ontario.
evidence.supports: Field 2: Corporate chain — Knock Knock English (Tokyo, 2003) → Super Simple Learning, Inc. (Seattle, incorporated 2009) → Skyship Entertainment Company (Toronto). Trademark ownership confirms Skyship as current operator.

evidence.snippet: 'SUPER SIMPLE LEARNING' is a registered trademark (Registration #8309691) owned by Skyship Entertainment Company, a Toronto, ON based entity.
evidence.supports: Field 2: Confirms Skyship Entertainment Company holds all Super Simple trademarks, headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, Canada.

evidence.snippet: 'On September 8, 2006, we uploaded a video of Teaching Tips for "The Bath Song", that features Devon, Tanja, and Jeremy-sensei demonstrating how to wash your hair, feet, knees and nose among other body parts.'
evidence.supports: Field 3: Channel creation date = September 8, 2006. First upload = 'The Bath Song | Teaching Tips' video.

evidence.snippet: 'The Bath Song | Teaching Tips | Super Simple Songs' — uploaded 20 years ago, 3.3M views. Still publicly accessible on the channel.
evidence.supports: Field 3: Earliest still-public upload confirmed as 'The Bath Song | Teaching Tips' (September 8, 2006).

evidence.snippet: 'TORONTO, CANADA: Toronto-based digital-first creator Skyship Entertainment™ has achieved an impressive milestone...' and '"We wanted to create songs and videos that were simple enough for young children learning English" says co-founder Devon Thagard.'
evidence.supports: Field 4: Operating location = Toronto, Ontario, Canada. Field 2: Skyship Entertainment is the operator.

evidence.snippet: Lists localized Super Simple YouTube channels in: 日本語 (Japanese), Español (Spanish), Русский (Russian), عربي (Arabic), bahasa Indonesia (Indonesian), Português (Portuguese). Main English channels include Super Simple Songs, Super Simple ABCs, Super Simple TV, and 14+ show-specific channels.
evidence.supports: Field 5: Languages — English primary; localized versions in Japanese, Spanish, Russian, Arabic, Indonesian, Portuguese.

evidence.snippet: 'Super Simple Songs is a Canadian YouTube channel and streaming media show... publishes animated videos of both traditional nursery rhymes and their own original children's songs.' Genres listed: Education, nursery rhymes.
evidence.supports: Field 6: Primary content category = children's nursery rhymes and educational content. Field 4: Canadian origin.

evidence.snippet: 'Skyship's team of over forty artists creates in a variety of styles, including 2D and 3D animation, puppetry, stop-motion, and live action. The Super Simple Songs® channel brings a mix of classic nursery rhymes and original kids' songs to a worldwide audience.'
evidence.supports: Field 7: Content supply model = original/commissioned animation produced entirely in-house by 40+ artist team using multiple production techniques.

evidence.snippet: 'Skyship Entertainment is based in Toronto and produces digital content for preschoolers... The company produces content (primarily for YouTube), handles its own financing and self-distributes.'
evidence.supports: Field 7: Self-financed, self-distributed, in-house production. Field 4: Toronto operating location confirmed.

evidence.snippet: 'Twinkle Twinkle Little Star | Nursery Rhymes for Kids | Super Simple Songs' — 193M views (single video), though the brand celebrates the video crossing 1 billion views (per Facebook post supersimpleofficial).
evidence.supports: Field 8: Representative work — Twinkle Twinkle Little Star (1B+ lifetime views per brand announcement).

evidence.snippet: 'Hello Hello! Can You Clap Your Hands? | Original Kids Song | Super Simple Songs' — 171M views.
evidence.supports: Field 8: Representative work — Hello Hello! Can You Clap Your Hands? (171M views).

evidence.snippet: 'This Is The Way | Daily Routines Song | Noodle & Pals' — 155M views. TikTok @supersimpleofficial claims it is the most viewed puppet music video on YouTube.
evidence.supports: Field 8: Representative work — This Is The Way (155M views; cited as most-viewed puppet video on YouTube).

evidence.snippet: 'Hello! | Kids Greeting Song and Feelings Song | Super Simple Songs' — 232M views.

'With 70+ million YouTube subscribers and more than 90 billion lifetime views... The 20-track collection includes the 6x multi-platinum "Twinkle Twinkle Little Star" and 2x multi-platinum "If You're Happy." Track list includes: Hello Hello, Five Little Ducks, This Is The Way, Apples And Bananas, My Happy Song, Baby Shark, Old MacDonald Had A Farm, Do You Like Broccoli Ice Cream?, Head Shoulders Knees And Toes, and more.
evidence.supports: Field 8: Representative works confirmed from official anniversary vinyl tracklist. Subscriber count 70M+, 90B+ lifetime views.
